# Security at Aikido and Noon

Aikido is a developer-first software security platform. We scan your source code, cloud, and runtime to show you which vulnerabilities are actually important to solve.

With Noon, our modern workforce security platform, we also protect your people: securing inboxes, protecting devices, governing AI use, and training your teams.

Security is built into the fabric of our products, team, infrastructure, and processes, so you can rest assured your data is safeguarded.

**Policies and procedures both apply to Aikido and Noon.**

### SOC 2 Type II Update

Published July 21, 2026

Our latest SOC 2 Type II audit report is officially complete, covering the audit period from **July 4, 2025, to July 3, 2026**.

As part of our commitment to continuous improvement and transparency, we expanded the scope of our audit this year to include both **Security** and **Availability** Trust Services Criteria:

- **Scope Expansion:** We added the Availability criterion to evaluate our operational resilience and keep raising the bar for our customers.

- **What’s Covered:** The audit validates our practices around system uptime, proactive performance monitoring, established RTO/RPO targets, and disaster recovery testing.


This update reflects our dedication to maintaining strong controls and our commitment to always doing better.

### Public Policy Updates

Published June 10, 2026

We’ve streamlined our public policies to make them cleaner and much easier to navigate:

- New Company Style: All documents have been refreshed to match our updated brand identity.

- Merged Policies: We’ve consolidated related topics to drastically reduce the total policy count.


These updates reflect our ongoing dedication to regulatory compliance in a much cleaner, easier-to-navigate format.

Read moreRead more about Public Policy Updates

Compliance

### Security & Compliance Update

Published January 23, 2026

We have completed the CSA STAR Level 1 self-assessment (CAIQ) and are now listed in the Cloud Security Alliance (CSA) STAR Registry.

CSA STAR Level 1 demonstrates our transparency around cloud security practices by mapping our controls against the CSA Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM). The completed self-assessment is publicly available via the CSA STAR Registry and has also been added to our Trust Center for easy access.

We view this as an important step in our ongoing commitment to security, risk management, and transparency.

Read moreRead more about Security & Compliance Update

Compliance

### Public Password Policy Release

Published January 22, 2026

We’ve published a public version of our Password Policy as part of our ongoing effort to increase transparency around how we protect access to Aikido Security systems and data.

The policy outlines our approach to strong authentication, password hygiene, and account protection, while intentionally omitting sensitive internal implementation details. This update reflects our continued commitment to security best practices and responsible access management.
